title: Predictors and Program Flow
summary: This module provides advanced DSPy predictors and program flow control mechanisms, enabling iterative refinement, tool-use, code execution, and aggregation strategies for complex tasks.

nodes.label: Best-of-N Selection
nodes.title: BestOfN Predictor
nodes.description: Runs a module multiple times and selects the best output based on a reward function or threshold, improving prediction quality.

nodes.label: Iterative Refinement
nodes.title: Refine Predictor
nodes.description: Refines a module's output by running it repeatedly, evaluating with a reward, and generating feedback for subsequent runs to improve performance.

nodes.label: Reasoning & Acting (ReAct)
nodes.title: ReAct Agent
nodes.description: An agent that iteratively reasons, selects tools, executes them, and observes results to achieve a goal, mimicking human problem-solving.

nodes.label: Program of Thought
nodes.title: ProgramOfThought Predictor
nodes.description: Executes Python programs in a sandbox, iteratively generating, executing, and refining code based on errors to solve problems.

nodes.label: Code Interpreter Agent
nodes.title: CodeAct Predictor
nodes.description: Combines ReAct and Program of Thought to solve problems by generating and executing Python code with predefined tools in an interpreter.

nodes.label: Recursive Language Model (RLM)
nodes.title: RLM Predictor
nodes.description: Allows an LLM to explore contexts and solve problems by writing and executing Python code in a REPL, including calling sub-LLMs as tools.

nodes.label: Multi-Chain Comparison
nodes.title: MultiChainComparison Predictor
nodes.description: Compares multiple LLM completions (attempts) for a task, generating a consolidated rationale and a final answer based on these attempts.

nodes.label: Avatar Agent
nodes.title: Avatar Agent
nodes.description: An agent that uses an LLM (Actor) and external tools to accomplish a goal through a sequence of iterative actions and tool calls.

nodes.label: Aggregate Predictions
nodes.title: Majority Aggregation
nodes.description: Determines the most common completion for a specified field from multiple predictions, handling normalization and ties.

nodes.label: Normalize Text
nodes.title: Default Normalize Function
nodes.description: A helper function to normalize text strings, typically used before aggregation, returning None for empty strings.

nodes.label: Feedback Generation Signature
nodes.title: OfferFeedback Signature
nodes.description: Defines the structure for generating blame and actionable advice for modules based on their execution trajectory and reward.

nodes.label: Module Inspector
nodes.title: Inspect Modules Utility
nodes.description: Utility function to inspect and format the definitions (signature, I/O fields, instructions) of sub-modules within a given program.

nodes.label: Actor Agent Signature
nodes.title: Actor Signature
nodes.description: Defines the signature for an LLM actor, guiding it to decide which tool to use and what input to provide for a given goal.

nodes.label: Base Module
nodes.title: dspy.Module
nodes.description: The foundational class for all DSPy modules, providing core functionality and structure.

nodes.label: Signature Definition
nodes.title: dspy.Signature
nodes.description: Defines the input and output fields, along with instructions, for guiding LLM calls.

nodes.label: Language Model (LM)
nodes.title: dspy.LM
nodes.description: Provides text generation capabilities, serving as the underlying LLM for DSPy predictors.

nodes.label: Code Interpreter
nodes.title: PythonInterpreter/CodeInterpreter
nodes.description: Executes Python code in a sandboxed environment, used by code-executing agents.

nodes.label: Tools
nodes.title: dspy.Tool/Callable
nodes.description: External functions or utilities that can be called by agents to perform specific actions or retrieve information.

nodes.label: Prediction Object
nodes.title: dspy.Prediction
nodes.description: The standard output format for DSPy modules, encapsulating the generated results.

nodes.label: Typed Predictor
nodes.title: dspy.TypedPredictor
nodes.description: A predictor that enforces type hints for its inputs and outputs, ensuring structured LLM interactions.

nodes.label: Predictor
nodes.title: dspy.Predict
nodes.description: A basic LLM call module that takes a signature and generates an output.

nodes.label: Chain of Thought
nodes.title: dspy.ChainOfThought
nodes.description: A predictor that generates intermediate reasoning steps before producing the final output.

nodes.label: REPL History & Variables
nodes.title: REPLHistory/REPLVariable
nodes.description: Manages the state, context, and history of interactions within a Read-Eval-Print Loop (REPL).

nodes.label: Reward Function
nodes.title: Callable Reward Function
nodes.description: A callable function that evaluates the quality of a prediction, returning a scalar reward value.

groups.label: Surface Modules
groups.title: Core Predictor & Program Flow Modules
groups.description: These are the primary user-facing modules that implement various prediction strategies and program flow controls.

groups.label: Generative Components
groups.title: LLM Interaction & Signature Components
groups.description: Components primarily involved in defining and guiding LLM-based generation processes.

groups.label: Analytical Components
groups.title: Evaluation & Utility Components
groups.description: Components focused on analyzing, aggregating, normalizing, or inspecting module behavior and outputs.
